text:
maya: Heads-up — we started rolling vanguard-2.1-ptq on canary-mirror yesterday and I'm seeing a tiny but consistent rise in funcall parse failures when traffic goes through grpc-proxy.

tom: Any logs? Is the failure path only via proxy or also direct-host?

maya: snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:11Z ERROR invoke: parsing failed for tool_call response
payload: '{\"action\": \"cite\", \"args\": [{]}'
model: vanguard-2.1-ptq
route: canary-mirror-1
```

shiv: That looks like a truncated JSON array — often streaming boundary or kv-cache suffix clipping. Did the ptq build change chunking/streaming defaults?

maya: We did tweak batching defaults to lower chunk_size to improve p50. No intentional streaming changes. Could be an interaction. Failures skew to long arg arrays and nested codeblocks.

eva: Product: noticed ~0.6% bump in non-actionable toolcall rejects on the canary workspace. Small but affects Search Assist flows.

maya: Repro: mirror canary-mirror-1, sample ~5k tool invocations, run schema-acceptance lint. Failure cluster at deep arrays and fenced codeblocks.

shiv: Plan: 1) reproduce with direct-host bypassing grpc-proxy; 2) replay with old chunk_size and streaming disabled; 3) run fuzz harness with suffix truncation.

tom: Spinning direct-host replica now, routing 2% of canary -> should see traffic in ~3m.

canary-bot: deployed canary-replay-2 to host-vanguard-2.1-direct at 2026-03-22T09:38:32Z :rocket:

maya: Local fuzz: seeded with golden prompts + random suffix truncations. Model outputs recover if we append a soft sentinel "\uE000" at the end. Suggests boundary misalignment, not content generation error.

shiv: Sentinel helps but is a workaround. Options:
- revert chunk_size to previous value (lowest risk)
- add soft-terminator in serializer for toolcall endpoints (medium risk)
- add parse-rescue wrapper (safest for correctness but adds CPU)

eva: Which is quickest to test/rollback?

shiv: Revert chunk_size is fastest and easy rollback. Serializer sentinel touches wire format. Parse-rescue is safe but raises CPU and latency slightly.

maya: I'll run the replay with reverted chunk_size first and post diffs. If no fix, enable parse-rescue on 5% mirrored subset. Also request a new metric: toolcall.parse_repaired to measure rescue success rate.

tom: Direct-host replica is up and collecting. Routing is live.

shiv: I'll add the metric with tags model=vanguard-2.1-ptq and route=canary-mirror-1, pushing in ~30m.

maya: Thanks. I'll produce a short runbook and small postmortem snippet after replay diffs. TL;DR: likely streaming boundary + chunking interaction on ptq canary. Revert chunk_size, instrument parse_repair, fallback to parser rescue or serializer sentinel if needed. :white_check_mark:
